english.title: Fail to preserve record of information, document or statement obtained on supply of regulated explosives precursor
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having supplied regulated explosives precursor, namely **(..SPECIFY PRECURSOR..), to a business customer, namely **(..SPECIFY CUSTOMER..), and made a record of the information, document and statement obtained from that customer in accordance with regulation 3(2) of the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023, failed to preserve the record for a period of 18 months beginning with the date on which the record was made
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3(1) and (5) of the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023 and sections 7(4) and 8(5) of the Poisons Act 1972.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant having supplied a regulated explosives precursor, namely **(..SPECIFY PRECURSOR..), to a business customer, namely **(..SPECIFY CUSTOMER..), and made a record of the information, document and statement obtained from that customer in accordance with regulation 3(2) of the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023, failed to preserve the record for a period of 18 months beginning with the date on which the record was made.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

In the case of a continuing offence, a further fine not exceeding one-tenth of level 4 on the standard scale for every day subsequent to the day on which the person is convicted of the offence during which the contravention or default continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Proceedings may be commenced at any time -
(a) within the period of 12 months next after the date of commission of the offence, or
(b) in the case of proceedings instituted by, or by the direction of, the Secretary of State, within the later to end of -
(i) that 12-month period, and (ii) the period of 3 months next after the date on which evidence sufficient in the Secretary of State's opinion to justify a prosecution for the offence comes to the Secretary of State's knowledge.

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
